# proxy-tools 0.1.0

Unmodified source from the PyPI proxy-tools 0.1.0 source distribution was built
into the included pure-Python wheel using pip/setuptools. No runtime source was
changed. The wheel metadata says MIT, while the original source header and
repository LICENSE.txt specify BSD. Both original notices are retained; the
upstream BSD license is reproduced in PROXY-TOOLS-LICENSE.txt.

Upstream: https://github.com/jtushman/proxy_tools
License source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jtushman/proxy_tools/master/LICENSE.txt
PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/proxy-tools/0.1.0/
